create table conferences (
    conference_id integer primary key,
    name varchar(10) not null
);

create table teams (
    team_id integer primary key,
    name varchar(40) not null,
    city varchar(40) not null,
    conference_id integer not null,
    foreign key (conference_id) references conferences (conference_id)
);

create table coaches (
    coach_id integer primary key,
    name varchar(50) not null,
    team_id integer not null,
    foreign key (team_id) references teams (team_id)
);

create table captains (
    captain_id integer primary key,
    name varchar(50) not null,
    team_id integer not null,
    foreign key (team_id) references teams (team_id)
);

create table games (
    game_id integer primary key,
    week integer not null,
    home_team_id integer not null,
    away_team_id integer not null,
    foreign key (home_team_id) references teams (team_id),
    foreign key (away_team_id) references teams (team_id)
);
 Who is the head coach of the Kansas City Chiefs?  
SELECT c.name
FROM coaches c
JOIN teams t ON c.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE t.name = 'Chiefs';

questionResults.question: Which teams are in the AFC?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT t.name
FROM teams t
JOIN conferences c ON t.conference_id = c.conference_id
WHERE c.name = 'AFC';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The AFC teams are the Bills, Dolphins, Patriots, Jets, Ravens, Bengals, Browns, Steelers, Texans, Colts, Jaguars, Titans, Broncos, Chiefs, Raiders, and Chargers.

questionResults.question: Who is the head coach of the Kansas City Chiefs?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM coaches c
JOIN teams t ON c.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE t.city = 'Kansas City' AND t.name = 'Chiefs';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Andy Reid is the head coach of the Kansas City Chiefs.

questionResults.question: Who is the team captain of the Buffalo Bills?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM captains c
JOIN teams t ON c.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE t.city = 'Buffalo' AND t.name = 'Bills';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The Buffalo Bills’ team captain is Josh Allen!

questionResults.question: Which teams play in week 1?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT t.name
FROM teams t
JOIN games g ON t.team_id = g.home_team_id OR t.team_id = g.away_team_id
WHERE g.week = 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Here are the teams playing in week 1: Patriots, Seahawks, Rams, 49ers, Bears, Panthers, Bengals, Buccaneers, Lions, Saints, Bills, Texans, Ravens, Colts, Browns, Jaguars, Steelers, Falcons, Jets, Titans, Chargers, Cardinals, Dolphins, Raiders, Packers, Vikings, Eagles, Commanders, Cowboys, Giants, Broncos, and Chiefs.

questionResults.question: Which AFC teams play at home in week 2?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT t.name
FROM teams t
JOIN games g ON t.team_id = g.home_team_id
JOIN conferences c ON t.conference_id = c.conference_id
WHERE g.week = 2 AND c.name = 'AFC';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The AFC teams playing at home in week 2 are the Bills, Ravens, Texans, Patriots, Jets, Titans, Broncos, Chargers, and Chiefs.

questionResults.question: Who coaches the team that Patrick Mahomes captains?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM coaches c
JOIN teams t ON c.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN captains cap ON cap.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE cap.name = 'Patrick Mahomes';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Andy Reid coaches the team Patrick Mahomes captains!
